featured.title: Nepal Flood Death Toll Surges Past 330 as Glacier Collapse Scale Becomes Clear
featured.excerpt: Scientists confirm an ice-rock avalanche, not an earthquake, triggered one of Nepal's worst natural disasters, with over 900 people still missing including dozens of Americans and 177 Indian pilgrims.
featured.image_caption: An aerial view shows houses buried under mud and debris following flash floods in Nepal on August 26, 2026. The floods killed over 330 people and left more than 900 missing across eight districts.
featured.nri_angle: 177 Indian pilgrims en route to Kailash Mansarovar are among the missing, 63 Americans unaccounted for, and downstream flooding prompted evacuations in Bihar — the disaster has direct implications for diaspora families across South Asia.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

editorial.title: Who Is Asha Sharma? The Wisconsin-Born Executive Who Never Made a Video Game — and Is Now Running Xbox
editorial.excerpt: Seven months after Microsoft handed her the Xbox controller, the former Instacart COO is cutting thousands of jobs, cutting Game Pass prices, and telling hard truths — guided by a mantra from her immigrant upbringing: clarity is kindness.
editorial.image_caption: Asha Sharma at the 2026 Xbox Showcase. She became CEO of Microsoft Gaming in February 2026, succeeding Phil Spencer.
editorial.nri_angle: Sharma's rise to the top of Xbox — and the racist backlash her appointment drew despite her Wisconsin birth — captures both the ascent and the friction of Indian-American leadership in 2026.
editorial.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: 'Avengers: Endgame Encore' Smashes ₹5 Crore in India Advance Sales, Eyes Re-Release Record
just_in.excerpt: A week before release, the Marvel reissue has sold 100,000 advance tickets and is gunning for Baahubali: The Epic's all-time re-release opening record.
just_in.image_caption: Captain America wielding Mjolnir in ‘Avengers: Endgame.’ The film’s re-release is projected to set an India advance-sales record.
just_in.nri_angle: Marvel's box-office clout in India — the diaspora's home-market moviegoing barometer — is back, with a re-release outpacing many fresh releases in advance sales.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: El Niño Raises Kerala Dengue Risk, IITM Study Finds; Cases Could Rise 20% by 2040
just_in.excerpt: A 14-year IITM analysis links Pacific warming to Kerala's dengue years — and the forecasting model behind it could warn health authorities five months ahead.
just_in.image_caption: Researchers at the Indian Institute of Technology Madras. An IITM study found El Niño’s warming effect could raise dengue cases 20% in some Indian cities by 2040.
just_in.nri_angle: Dengue surges hit Kerala's families — and the diaspora that travels home during monsoon season — making advance forecasting a lifeline for return visits.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Indian Migrant First Person Charged Under UK's New Online Immigration Crime Law
just_in.excerpt: Hem Raj, 24, was arrested in Smethwick over social media posts allegedly coaching migrants on fraudulent visa and asylum applications.
just_in.image_caption: National Crime Agency and police officers. Hem Raj, a 25-year-old Indian migrant, is the first person charged under Britain’s new online immigration crime law.
just_in.nri_angle: The case is a warning to diaspora communities where unregulated 'agents' operate on social media — fraudulent advice can now mean a criminal record under Britain's new online-advertising offence.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Saudi Aramco Halts Crude Supplies to India as Pipeline Shutdown Bites
just_in.excerpt: With the East-West pipeline down, the kingdom's state oil company has told Indian refiners no term crude is coming — forcing expensive spot-market replacements.
just_in.image_caption: A Saudi Aramco oil facility. Aramco halted crude supplies to Indian refiners after a pipeline shutdown disrupted shipments.
just_in.nri_angle: Higher crude costs feed directly into India's import bill and fuel prices, squeezing the remittance value and household budgets of NRIs tied to the Indian economy.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Deepika and Ranveer Seek Siddhivinayak Blessings Ahead of Second Child's Birth
just_in.excerpt: The couple repeated the Siddhivinayak pilgrimage they made before daughter Dua's birth, arriving in matching purple as Ganeshotsav filled Mumbai.
just_in.image_caption: Deepika Padukone at a public appearance. The actor and husband Ranveer Singh visited the Siddhivinayak Temple in Mumbai ahead of the birth of their second child.
just_in.nri_angle: Deepika and Ranveer's temple pilgrimage before each child's birth resonates with diaspora families who keep their own faith traditions alive across continents.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Krishnamoorthi Breaks With Indian-American Democrats on Russia Sanctions Vote
just_in.excerpt: The Illinois Democrat was the sole Indian-origin House member to back the Graham sanctions bill carrying 100% tariff authority on Russian oil buyers including India.
just_in.image_caption: U.S. Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi. The Illinois congressman broke with fellow Indian-American Democrats on a Russia sanctions vote.
just_in.nri_angle: Krishnamoorthi's vote puts a senior Indian-American lawmaker on the opposite side of a bill that could hit India with 100% tariffs over Russian oil — a fault line the diaspora will debate.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: India Turns to Diaspora in Nagoya as Asian Games Accommodation Crisis Deepens
just_in.excerpt: With athletes evacuated from flooded container rooms and India's shooting team left waiting until 3 a.m., some 2,000 Indians in Nagoya stand ready to open their homes.
just_in.image_caption: Nagoya at night, host city of the 2026 Asian Games. The city is facing an accommodation crunch that has pushed India to lean on its diaspora.
just_in.nri_angle: The Indian diaspora in Japan is literally opening its homes to athletes, turning a host-organiser failure into a showcase of community mobilization.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Katrina Kaif on Postpartum Skin, Beauty Standards and Feeling Her Best
just_in.excerpt: After facing trolling over her postpartum appearance, the actor says motherhood rebuilt her approach to skincare — and to what beauty means.
just_in.image_caption: Katrina Kaif at a recent appearance. The actor has spoken about postpartum body image after facing online trolling.
just_in.nri_angle: The postpartum body-shaming debate resonates with diaspora mothers navigating the same pressures across cultures — where family scrutiny can be as sharp as social media's.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Air India Weighs Folding Budget Arm AI Express Into Parent Group to Trim Losses
just_in.excerpt: Incoming CEO Tewolde Gebremariam has questioned why the Tata carrier runs two separate airline companies, arguing a single group would lower regulatory costs and duplicate management.
just_in.image_caption: An Air India aircraft on the tarmac. Air India is weighing folding its budget arm AI Express into the parent group to trim losses.
just_in.nri_angle: The Indian diaspora — among the world's most frequent flyers on India routes — would feel any restructuring through fares, network consolidation, and service reliability at the Tata carrier.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Three Indian-Origin Researchers Used Claude to Break Into OpenAI in 72 Hours
just_in.excerpt: Harsh Jaiswal, Mohan Pedhapati and Rahul Maini chained two vulnerabilities from OpenAI's public forum to employee accounts, then disclosed it for a $6,500 bounty.
just_in.image_caption: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman at a public appearance. The attempted breach targeted OpenAI internal systems, according to a new cybersecurity report.
just_in.nri_angle: Three Indian-origin security researchers delivered the most embarrassing demonstration yet of AI-era vulnerability — breaking into OpenAI with a rival's model in 72 hours.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Salesforce Unveils AIforce and Koa Reasoning Model at Dreamforce 2026
just_in.excerpt: At Dreamforce Day 1, Salesforce launched AIforce, a live interface layer that takes CRM to any tool, and Koa, its first CRM reasoning model built on NVIDIA Nemotron.
just_in.image_caption: Salesforce's official artwork for AIforce, the live interface layer unveiled at Dreamforce 2026. The company also introduced Koa, its first CRM reasoning model built on NVIDIA Nemotron.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian IT services firms and enterprise teams are among Salesforce's largest implementation partners globally, and the agent-interface shift promises a new services wave built around AIforce.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Canada Weighs Winding Down 41-Year Kanishka Bombing Probe, Drawing Anguish From Victims' Families
just_in.excerpt: The RCMP briefed victims' families on plans to scale back the investigation into the 1985 Air India bombing; families have written to PM Mark Carney demanding the probe be renewed, not retired.
just_in.image_caption: Wreckage from Air India Flight 182 recovered from the Atlantic after the June 23, 1985 bombing. Victims' families were briefed on September 12 about a possible move to scale back the 41-year-old RCMP investigation.
just_in.nri_angle: The bombing killed 268 Canadians, largely of Indian origin; the probe's fate is deeply personal to the Indo-Canadian diaspora and sits at the centre of strained India-Canada relations.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Air India Combined Loss More Than Doubles to ₹22,238 Crore in FY26
just_in.excerpt: Tata Group-owned Air India and Air India Express posted a record combined net loss as revenue slipped 9%, with chairman N. Chandrasekaran framing the turnaround as a five-to-ten-year journey.
just_in.image_caption: An Air India Airbus A320neo in the airline's new Tata-era livery taxis on a runway. Air India and Air India Express reported a record combined net loss of ₹22,238 crore in FY26, more than double the previous year's loss.
just_in.nri_angle: Air India is the primary carrier connecting millions of overseas Indians to home; its financial strain and turnaround shape fares, network reliability, and Gulf/UK/North America connectivity for the diaspora.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: India Women Open Asian Games Title Defence Against Japan in Cricket Quarter-Final
just_in.excerpt: Harmanpreet Kaur's defending champions face hosts Japan in the first-ever women's T20I between the sides, with the winner advancing to Saturday's semi-final against Bangladesh.
just_in.image_caption: Shafali Verma bats for India. Defending champions India opened their Asian Games 2026 women's cricket title defence against hosts Japan at Korogi Athletic Park in Nisshin.
just_in.nri_angle: Cricket's global moment — a World Cup nation facing an Associate host at a multi-sport Games — is exactly the kind of fixture that plays to diaspora audiences across time zones, with free DD Sports coverage and SonyLIV streaming.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Vikrant Massey Turns 'Musafir Cafe' Into Real Hill Cafés in Himachal and Uttarakhand
just_in.excerpt: The actor's production house Homemade Stories is building two replicas of the show's café — plus around 20 artist-residency rooms — extending the Netflix series' world beyond the screen.
just_in.image_caption: Vikrant Massey in Musafir Cafe, the Netflix series where he plays Chander. The actor is building two real-life replicas of the show's café in Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand.
just_in.nri_angle: For diaspora travellers heading to the Himalayan hills, Massey's cafés add two new screen-famous addresses to the map — with artist residencies that echo the show's creative-retreat theme.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Asian Games Chief Calls Container Rooms 'Functional' as OCA Defends Scrapping Athletes' Village
news.excerpt: Organising committee president Hideaki Omura promised fixes as delegations complain of short beds, leaking huts and long waits — while the OCA says a traditional village would have been a costly white elephant.
news.image_caption: Container-style accommodation units for athletes at the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Games. Organising committee president Hideaki Omura called the rooms 'functional' amid complaints about cramped quarters and short beds.
news.nri_angle: Indian athletes faced 14-hour waits and missing registrations at the Nagoya Games, and the accommodation row is unfolding just as India's teams begin their medal campaigns.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Sikh Truck Driver Stabbed 17 Times at Wyoming Rest Stop, Suspect Charged
news.excerpt: The 28-year-old Sacramento driver was followed into a restroom at the Bitter Creek Rest Area along I-80 in the early hours of Sept. 13 and airlifted to a Casper hospital; Andrew Kris Bzdak, 45, was arrested and charged with attempted first-degree murder.
news.image_caption: Interstate 80 in Wyoming. The Sikh truck driver was attacked at the Bitter Creek Rest Area along the highway in Sweetwater County on Sept. 13; the suspect was charged with attempted first-degree murder.
news.nri_angle: A Sikh long-haul trucker from California's diaspora community was nearly killed on a U.S. highway days after federal immigration rhetoric mocked a turbaned Sikh driver, forcing Sikh Americans to confront the physical risks of anti-South Asian hostility.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Russian Missile and Drone Barrage Across Ukraine Injures at Least 19
news.excerpt: Overnight strikes on Kyiv, Zaporizhzhia and Odesa land days after Trump's claim of an energy-truce deal — while Ukraine hits a Russian refinery and airbase in return.
news.image_caption: Firefighters work below a Kyiv residential apartment building with shattered windows in the aftermath of a Russian strike. At least 19 people were injured in Russian missile and drone attacks across Ukraine on September 17.
news.nri_angle: Indian students and workers remain in Ukraine, and an Indian citizen was killed in a Russian strike on Boryspil outside Kyiv earlier this month, according to Reuters.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Trump Says Houthis Asked US to Stay Out as They Seize Red Sea Chokepoint
news.excerpt: President Trump said Yemen's Houthis asked Washington not to intervene even as the Iran-backed group seized control of the Bab al-Mandeb Strait — putting a second major energy chokepoint under threat and driving oil above $100 a barrel.
news.image_caption: President Donald Trump walks across a tarmac in front of Marine One at dusk. In Dublin on September 12, Trump said Yemen's Houthis had asked the US not to intervene against them even as they seized control of the Bab al-Mandeb Strait.
news.nri_angle: Indian seafarers crewing merchant ships through the Red Sea face heightened risk, and sustained $100-plus oil with higher freight costs hits Indian consumers and importers directly.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Indian-Origin Texas Lab Owner on US Fugitive List Over $93M Medicare Fraud
news.excerpt: Khadeer Khan Mohammed, 46, is accused of billing Medicare $93 million for genetic tests doctors never ordered; HHS investigators say the alleged fugitive may be in Hyderabad, India.
news.image_caption: Khadeer Khan Mohammed. The Richardson, Texas lab owner is on the HHS-OIG fugitive list over 3 million in alleged fraudulent Medicare claims. (Photo: HHS-OIG)
news.nri_angle: An Indian-origin name on a U.S. federal fugitive list draws outsized attention in the Indian-American community — heavily represented in the very healthcare fields this alleged fraud exploited — even though the charges remain allegations.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: House Passes Graham Russia Sanctions Bill 262-159, Putting India in 100% Tariff Crosshairs
news.excerpt: Named for the late Sen. Lindsey Graham, the package authorises President Trump to impose tariffs of up to 100% on the top importers of Russian energy; the Kremlin said Thursday the move would 'complicate' Ukraine peace efforts.
news.image_caption: The dome of the US Capitol in Washington, DC, with the American flag flying. The House of Representatives passed the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act by 262-159 on Wednesday, sending it to President Trump for his signature.
news.nri_angle: India is directly in the bill's crosshairs — New Delhi's Russian oil purchases could expose Indian exports to tariffs of up to 100%, and India has already warned Washington that such measures would damage bilateral ties.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Warns US That New Tariffs Over Russian Oil Could Damage Ties
news.excerpt: Hours after the US House passed a bill authorizing tariffs of up to 100% on top Russian oil buyers, New Delhi cautioned Washington that the move could strain the bilateral relationship and vowed to protect its energy security.
news.image_caption: An image from Mint's coverage of US-India trade relations. India warned on September 17 that a US House bill authorizing tariffs of up to 100% on buyers of Russian oil could damage bilateral ties.
news.nri_angle: For the diaspora, the standoff touches Indian-American importers, energy and trade professionals, and the US-India commercial corridor, all of which would feel the impact if the tariff weapon is actually deployed.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Finneas, Other Acts Quit Ed Sheeran Tour After Macklemore Ousted Over Palestine
news.excerpt: Finneas, Aaron Rowe, Lukas Graham and Sheeran's own touring band Beoga walked out on Tuesday, accusing stadium owners led by Robert Kraft of silencing the rapper's onstage "Free Palestine" remarks.
news.image_caption: Singer-songwriter and producer Finneas O'Connell. He quit Ed Sheeran's Loop Tour after Macklemore was dropped from the lineup.
news.nri_angle: For Indian-diaspora readers, the fallout is another reminder of how sharply pro-Palestinian speech is policed on Western pop's biggest stages.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Von der Leyen Pledges EU 'Counter-Hybrid Playbook,' Offers Canada Associate Membership
news.excerpt: In a 73-minute State of the Union address in Strasbourg, the European Commission president unveiled a European 'Article 4' emergency security protocol, a tougher stance on China, and a frontier-AI pact — warning that threats are mounting on European soil.
news.image_caption: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen. She proposed a 'counter-hybrid playbook' for EU states facing sabotage and drone incursions.
news.nri_angle: The speech signals tighter EU borders and faster migrant returns alongside expanded legal migration channels and skills initiatives, a mix that matters for the Indian professionals and students who form one of the largest migrant communities in several EU states.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Galwan War Film's Long Road Shows India's Softening Line on China
news.excerpt: Salman Khan's Maatrubhumi — announced as Battle of Galwan — has been stalled by a defence ministry directive as India recalibrates its China policy, and TRT World says the saga reads like a barometer of that thaw.
news.nri_angle: The saga shows how New Delhi's China reset is reaching beyond diplomacy into the stories Bollywood is allowed to tell — a shift diaspora audiences will feel on screen before they see it in policy.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Amazon Wants 1,000 Same-Day Delivery Hubs Within 10 Miles of Prime Members
news.excerpt: Codenamed Project Mercury, the internal plan would grow Amazon's same-day footprint from 85 sites to more than 1,000 by 2031, placing hubs within a 10-mile radius of 80% of US Prime subscribers. Amazon says the projections are preliminary and subject to revision.
news.image_caption: An Amazon fulfillment center. Amazon is planning an internal initiative, codenamed Project Mercury, to expand its same-day delivery network from about 85 facilities to more than 1,000 sites by 2031.
news.nri_angle: For Indian-American families who rely on Amazon for everything from weekly groceries to festival-season essentials, a same-day hub within a 10-mile radius would narrow the last real advantage of the neighborhood store.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: War-Damaged Gaza Apartment Block Collapses, Killing at Least 20
news.excerpt: The al-Sa'ada building in Gaza City's Rimal neighborhood collapsed overnight with about 100 people believed trapped, exposing the perilous living conditions of displaced Palestinians as reconstruction remains stalled.
news.nri_angle: For Indian readers following the war's humanitarian toll, the collapse shows how Gaza's destruction keeps claiming lives beyond the battlefield, through the damaged buildings displaced families are forced to shelter in.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Cabinet Raises EPFO Wage Ceiling to ₹25,000 After 12 Years
news.excerpt: The Union Cabinet's decision to lift the mandatory EPFO coverage ceiling from ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 a month will bring over 51 lakh more workers into provident fund, pension and insurance coverage from September 17.
news.nri_angle: Millions of NRIs hold dormant EPF accounts from earlier India stints, and families back home in the ₹15,000–₹25,000 band now gain retirement savings, pension eligibility and insurance protection.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Houthis Claim Missile Strike on Aramco Facilities in Yanbu
news.excerpt: The unverified claim targets Saudi Arabia's main Red Sea oil port — the linchpin of Riyadh's crude rerouting around the closed Strait of Hormuz — as Brent climbs to $107.80.
news.image_caption: A Houthi military spokesman addresses a press conference. The Houthis claimed a missile strike on Aramco facilities in Yanbu, Saudi Arabia.
news.nri_angle: India, the world's third-largest oil importer, absorbs every Brent price spike into its import bill and fuel prices — and Red Sea disruption hits the route carrying much of its Gulf crude.
news.author: Diaspora Desk
