nri-world.excerpt: Telangana CM A. Revanth Reddy announced Thursday that Harvard executive education programmes will launch in Hyderabad in December 2026, with MIT and Purdue offshore campuses also in the works as the state pushes to become a global knowledge hub.
nri-world.image_caption: A Telangana government delegation poses with Harvard representatives in Hyderabad. Harvard will offer executive education courses in Hyderabad starting December.
nri-world.nri_angle: Harvard executive courses in Hyderabad give diaspora professionals a mid-career credential from a globally recognised brand without leaving India, while dual-degree and research partnerships could pull diaspora academics into Hyderabad's institutions.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Edmonton South Asians finalize plans with city for central Diwali festival
nri-world.excerpt: After October 2025 Diwali fireworks sparked fires and a wave of hate, South Asian leaders and the City of Edmonton are finalizing a Canada Day-style central celebration at Mill Woods Park, with permits pending and details expected within weeks.
nri-world.image_caption: Spectators watch a fireworks display light up the night sky. Edmonton community leaders want a professionally run central Diwali fireworks show at Mill Woods Park to replace the backyard displays that sparked fires last October.
nri-world.nri_angle: Edmonton's South Asian leaders are converting a crisis — Diwali 2025 fireworks fires and the hate that followed — into civic recognition by co-building a city-partnered, Canada Day-style Diwali festival open to all.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Canberra University's T20 Cricket Challenge Opens Study-Play Pathway for Indian Teens
nri-world.excerpt: The third University of Canberra Cricket Challenge wrapped up in Bengaluru on September 4, drawing more than 300 young athletes from across India. Indian school teams now head to Canberra for the next leg later this month.
nri-world.image_caption: A youth cricket team in University of Canberra jerseys poses for a team photo in front of UC, Cricket ACT Australia and Jain International Residential School banners. The photo was taken during the third UC Cricket Challenge in Bengaluru, held August 30 to September 4, which brought more than 300 young cricketers from across India to compete and attend study-in-Australia workshops.
nri-world.nri_angle: The tournament gives Indian families a low-pressure introduction to an Australian university and offers a credible 'study and play' route for cricket-obsessed students to pair an Australian degree with elite training.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: 'I'm staying, so is the curry': Krishnamoorthi hits back at 'go home' jibe
nri-world.excerpt: U.S. Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi answered Palm Bay councilman Chandler Langevin's 'take your curry and go home' post by calling America his home and refusing to let anyone decide who belongs in the country.
nri-world.image_caption: U.S. Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi at an event in Washington, D.C. The Illinois Democrat told Palm Bay councilman Chandler Langevin this week: "I am staying. So is the curry. America is my home."
nri-world.nri_angle: An Indian-origin U.S. congressman publicly rejects a Florida councilman's 'go home' taunt, turning a recurring anti-Indian attack into a defense of who belongs in America.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Tata Sons Board Reinstates Chandrasekaran for Five Years; Trusts Call Move Illegal
nri-world.excerpt: The board reversed Chandrasekaran's August decision to step down, but controlling shareholder Tata Trusts says the majority vote was a "legal nullity" — and the RBI has revived the long-dodged listing question.
nri-world.image_caption: File photo of N. Chandrasekaran, executive chairman of Tata Sons. On September 17, 2026, the Tata Sons board voted to reappoint him for a third five-year term, a move Tata Trusts called a legal nullity.
nri-world.nri_angle: For diaspora investors, the stakes are direct: TCS is a top Indian-American portfolio holding and a Tata Sons listing could be one of the largest IPOs in Indian history.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: US Firm Accused of Firing Entire 80-Member Indian Support Team on 5-Minute Call
nri-world.excerpt: According to an employee's viral account, a US-based company — described in reports as a bank — dismissed its whole Indian customer service team in a single brief Google Meet call. The allegation has not been independently verified.
nri-world.image_caption: A customer service call center in India. A US-based company was accused of firing its entire 80-member Indian support team during a five-minute Google Meet call, in an account that has not been independently verified.
nri-world.nri_angle: Tens of thousands of Indian professionals staff customer service and back-office operations for US companies remotely, and an alleged five-minute dismissal of an entire 80-person team underscores how precarious that arrangement can be.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Supreme Court Demands Answers on 34 Unnatural Deaths in Manipur Relief Camps
nri-world.excerpt: A bench led by Chief Justice Surya Kant ordered Manipur's chief secretary to file an affidavit explaining why post-mortems were conducted in only 20 cases and why bereaved families received as little as Rs 20,000 in compensation.
nri-world.image_caption: A photograph from the Supreme Court Observer's coverage of the Manipur hearing. On September 17, the Supreme Court expressed shock over 34 unnatural deaths in relief camps and directed the state's chief secretary to file an affidavit accounting for each one.
nri-world.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora — including human-rights advocates and community groups that have followed Manipur closely since 2023 — the Supreme Court's intervention signals that accountability for the displaced extends beyond the violence itself to the conditions in which survivors are living and dying.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Hyderabad Man Dies in US 17 Days After Wedding; Family Seeks Jaishankar's Help
nri-world.excerpt: Mohammed Jaber Hussain, 27, died in Lowell, Massachusetts, on September 14. His family, citing financial hardship, has appealed to EAM S. Jaishankar and Hyderabad MP Asaduddin Owaisi for help bringing his body home.
nri-world.nri_angle: A Hyderabad family's sudden loss in Massachusetts exposes the financial and bureaucratic burden diaspora families face repatriating loved ones from the US, and their routine reliance on EAM intervention and consular coordination.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Sethuraman Panchanathan Becomes First Indian American to Win NAE's Bueche Award
nri-world.excerpt: The former NSF director, now a University Professor of Technology and Innovation at Arizona State University, was cited for advancing translational research and U.S. science policy. He will receive the 2026 award on Oct. 4 in Washington, D.C.
nri-world.image_caption: Sethuraman Panchanathan. He is the first Indian American to receive the National Academy of Engineering's Arthur M. Bueche Award.
nri-world.nri_angle: A Chennai-born scientist who rose to lead U.S. science funding becomes the first Indian American honored by the National Academy of Engineering for shaping national science and technology policy.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: "Talent Is Universal, Opportunity Is Not": Wadhwani Foundation CEO Dr. Ajay Kela on Why the Diaspora's Greatest Asset Isn't Money
nri-world.excerpt: In an exclusive interview with The Videshi, the CEO of Wadhwani Foundation talks about India's innovation ecosystem, the "missing middle" of Indian entrepreneurship, and why the diaspora's most powerful currency isn't capital — it's knowledge.
nri-world.image_caption: Dr. Ajay Kela, CEO and Board Member of Wadhwani Foundation, leads the organization's mission to create 5 million jobs and upskill 25 million people across emerging economies.
nri-world.nri_angle: Interview with Dr. Ajay Kela, NRI leader who returned to India to lead Wadhwani Foundation — covers diaspora giving back, deep-tech opportunities, and India's innovation ecosystem.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Indian Migrant First Person Charged Under UK's New Online Immigration Crime Law
immigration.excerpt: Hem Raj, 24, was arrested in Smethwick over social media posts allegedly coaching migrants on fraudulent visa and asylum applications.
immigration.image_caption: National Crime Agency and police officers. Hem Raj, a 25-year-old Indian migrant, is the first person charged under Britain’s new online immigration crime law.
immigration.nri_angle: The case is a warning to diaspora communities where unregulated 'agents' operate on social media — fraudulent advice can now mean a criminal record under Britain's new online-advertising offence.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Aadhaar Is Going Global: UIDAI Working to Let NRIs and OCIs Enrol Without India Stay
immigration.excerpt: UIDAI chief Saurabh Vijay told Global Fintech Fest 2026 that proof-of-concept work is underway and a legal framework is being built to give overseas Indians access to the digital ID system.
immigration.image_caption: An Aadhaar Seva Kendra enrolment centre. UIDAI is building a legal framework to let NRIs and OCI cardholders enrol without the current India-stay requirements.
immigration.nri_angle: Aadhaar going global would let NRIs and OCIs enrol remotely, unlocking easier KYC for Indian bank accounts, investments and property without a 182-day India stay.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Australia to Bar Most Student Visa Holders From Bringing Families in Migration Crackdown
immigration.excerpt: Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke unveiled the restrictions on Thursday as part of a broader overhaul targeting net migration of 225,000 by 2028 — a direct hit to the A$53.6 billion international education sector that depends heavily on Indian students.
immigration.image_caption: Australia is barring most student visa holders from bringing family members as part of a migration crackdown. The policy targets dependents of international students at Australian universities.
immigration.nri_angle: The restrictions hit a core diaspora pathway: Indian students, one of Australia's largest international-student cohorts, commonly relocate with spouses and children, and many will now have to choose between leaving family behind or picking another country.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: New public charge rule takes effect Friday; Indian green card applicants face wider scrutiny
immigration.excerpt: Starting September 18, immigration officers gain broader discretion to weigh Medicaid, SNAP and school-meal use when deciding whether applicants could become dependent on government aid. Twenty-one states and D.C. sued this week to block the rule.
immigration.image_caption: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani and Attorney General Letitia James announce the lawsuits challenging the new public charge rule at a City Hall news conference. Twenty-one states and D.C. sued to block the rule, which takes effect September 18.
immigration.nri_angle: For Indian families, the expanded public charge test most affects family-sponsored green card cases and visa applications — where benefits used by a spouse, child or household member can now factor into an officer's decision.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Amazon Raises Minimum Pay to $20 an Hour, Adds Whole Foods Discounts
immigration.excerpt: The $1.5 billion pay raise lifts starting wages for US full-time fulfillment and delivery workers to $20 an hour starting September 27, with average pay near $24 — plus new Whole Foods grocery discounts and a lifetime no-fee banking benefit.
immigration.image_caption: A worker scans a package inside an Amazon fulfillment center. Amazon is raising minimum starting pay for US full-time core operations employees to $20 an hour, with average pay reaching nearly $24.
immigration.nri_angle: Amazon's warehouse and delivery workforce is heavily immigrant, and the new no-credit-history banking benefit directly addresses an early hurdle for newcomers; the announcement was authored by Udit Madan, the Indian-origin SVP of Worldwide Operations.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: H-1B Worker's Immigration Anxiety Becomes the App Visawise
immigration.excerpt: Kadambi built an app to manage life on a work visa — status tracking, rental and tax guidance — in the toughest year the H-1B program has faced.
immigration.image_caption: Karthik Kadambi, the H-1B worker who built the Visawise app.
immigration.nri_angle: With Indians making up 71% of H-1B approvals, a diaspora-built tool for visa anxiety is a direct response to the policy shocks hitting Indian workers hardest this year.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Rubio Announces Visa Curbs on South Africans Over Alleged Race-Based Discrimination
immigration.excerpt: The restrictions target those allegedly complicit in land seizures and discrimination against minorities; Pretoria says its apartheid-redress policies have been mischaracterized by fringe groups, and the U.S. ambassador hints at more measures to come.
immigration.image_caption: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio speaks to reporters. Rubio announced visa restrictions targeting South Africans deemed responsible for alleged race-based discrimination.
immigration.nri_angle: The move extends a pattern of nationality-targeted US immigration restrictions, relevant to Indians who travel, study, and work across Africa as well as to the 1.5 million-strong Indian-origin community in South Africa.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Air India CEO Summoned Over Immigration Lapse as Leadership Arrives at Bombay House
immigration.excerpt: The Centre has summoned Air India chief Tewolde Gebremariam over the departure of three Italian nationals from Delhi without immigration clearance, as he and predecessor Campbell Wilson arrived together at Bombay House in Mumbai.
immigration.image_caption: Air India CEO and MD Tewolde Gebremariam at Bombay House, the Tata Group headquarters, in Mumbai. He arrived there on September 15 with predecessor Campbell Wilson as the Centre summoned the airline chief over an alleged immigration lapse at Delhi airport.
immigration.nri_angle: Diaspora travelers transiting through Delhi on domestic-to-international connections — the most common itinerary for Indians flying home — should verify immigration and transfer channels themselves, since this lapse shows a boarding pass and checked-through bag don't guarantee formalities were completed.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: New Lawsuits Challenge Trump's Green Card Freeze on Applicants From 75 Countries
immigration.excerpt: A 130-plaintiff lawsuit filed in Washington this week accuses the State Department of unlawfully continuing its nationality-based suspension of immigrant visas, weeks after a New York judge struck the policy down as 'patently unlawful.'
immigration.image_caption: Officials and advocates stand at a podium bearing the New York City seal, holding signs including "Immigrants Are New York." New federal lawsuits are challenging the Trump administration immigrant-visa freeze affecting applicants from 75 countries.
immigration.nri_angle: NRIs sit at the center of every front in this fight — family-sponsored applicants stuck in the freeze, and H-1B workers whose adjustment-of-status path a new memo would push back to their home country.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Air India Combined Loss More Than Doubles to ₹22,238 Crore in FY26
markets-finance.excerpt: Tata Group-owned Air India and Air India Express posted a record combined net loss as revenue slipped 9%, with chairman N. Chandrasekaran framing the turnaround as a five-to-ten-year journey.
markets-finance.image_caption: An Air India Airbus A320neo in the airline's new Tata-era livery taxis on a runway. Air India and Air India Express reported a record combined net loss of ₹22,238 crore in FY26, more than double the previous year's loss.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Air India is the primary carrier connecting millions of overseas Indians to home; its financial strain and turnaround shape fares, network reliability, and Gulf/UK/North America connectivity for the diaspora.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Shapoor Mistry Backs Tata Sons Listing as RBI Directive Clears Path
markets-finance.excerpt: The Shapoorji Pallonji Group chairman welcomed the Reserve Bank's refusal to let Tata Sons deregister as an NBFC, calling a public listing a bridge between private ownership and public accountability amid a deepening boardroom rift.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Shapoorji Pallonji Engineering and Construction building in Hyderabad. Group chairman Shapoor Mistry welcomed the RBI’s September 11 decision pushing Tata Sons toward a public listing.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Tata group equities and ADRs sit in many Indian-diaspora portfolios, so a clearer regulatory path and stronger holding-company governance directly affect the value of those investments.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Rentomojo debuts at 19% premium, then rallies further on NSE
markets-finance.excerpt: The furniture-rental platform opened at ₹482.45, a 19.42% premium to its ₹404 IPO price, and climbed to ₹526.70 within an hour; the ₹1,255.57-crore issue was subscribed nearly 73 times.
markets-finance.image_caption: Coverage of Rentomojo's market debut. The furniture-rental platform opened at Rs 482.45 on the NSE — a 19.42% premium over its Rs 404 IPO price — and rallied about 9% further within the first hour of trade.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Rentomojo's debut sets the benchmark valuation for India's rental-economy sector and signals to global investors how the Indian consumer subscription market is being priced.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Fed Raises Rates for First Time in Three Years, Defying Trump's Demand for Cuts
markets-finance.excerpt: In a unanimous 12-0 vote, Chairman Kevin Warsh led the Federal Reserve's first rate increase since July 2023, lifting the benchmark to 3.75%-4% to fight inflation running near 4% — and signaling one more hike before year-end.
markets-finance.image_caption: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh speaks at a press conference in Washington. The Fed raised its benchmark rate to 3.75%-4% on Wednesday, its first increase in more than three years.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Higher US rates and a stronger dollar pressure the rupee and emerging-market assets, affecting NRI portfolios, remittance values, and dollar-denominated borrowing costs.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: HSBC, ICICI Lead GIFT City's $19.3 Billion NRI Lending Boom
markets-finance.excerpt: Moneycontrol reported NRI-linked lending at $19.3 billion as banks use offshore GIFT City units to offer leveraged FCNR-B deposits, riding the RBI's hedging-cost subsidies.
markets-finance.image_caption: The ICICI Bank branch at K.G. Marg in New Delhi. ICICI is among the lenders financing GIFT City's fast-growing NRI loan book, where a new deposit scheme is drawing heavy dollar inflows from overseas Indians.
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRIs in the Gulf and US are the direct beneficiaries: leveraged FCNR-B deposits through GIFT City offer dollar yields well above Western rates, but the September 30 window and rollover risk demand attention.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: J.B. Hunt Shares Sink 13% After Warning Q3 Earnings Will Fall
markets-finance.excerpt: CFO Brad Delco said third-quarter earnings will fall 5% to 10% from the second quarter as $25 million in driver costs and surging diesel prices squeeze margins — a rare intra-quarter warning that sent the stock to its steepest drop of the year.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Freight costs ripple into goods prices and retail/manufacturing margins, so investors can treat the diesel-driven intermodal pricing advantage as a portfolio signal even without direct exposure to trucking.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: US Retail Sales Rebound 1.2% in August as Consumers Keep Spending
markets-finance.excerpt: Shoppers stepped up purchases of cars and back-to-school goods in August, Commerce Department data showed Wednesday, underscoring a resilient economy just as the Federal Reserve moved to raise interest rates.
markets-finance.image_caption: A shopper browsing clothes at a US retail store. US retail sales rebounded 1.2% in August as consumers kept spending.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Mainly financial: Fed rate hikes raise borrowing costs on US mortgages, auto loans and credit cards for Indian-American households, while strong consumer demand supports equity portfolios.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Iran War's One-Two Punch of Oil and Rates Costs U.S. Households $1,700 Each
markets-finance.excerpt: A Moody's Analytics tally puts the total cost of the U.S.-Iran conflict at about $1,760 per American household — $930 of it from energy, $425 from higher interest rates, and $405 from military spending.
markets-finance.image_caption: A customer fills up at an Exxon station, with gasoline prices displayed on the sign. Moody's Analytics estimates the US-Iran war has cost American households about ,760 each in higher energy and borrowing costs.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Higher fuel, borrowing, and grocery costs hit diaspora households — many concentrated in car-dependent suburbs with long commutes — exactly like every other American family.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: NZ Super Fund, World's Top-Performing Sovereign Wealth Fund, Warns Equity Pullback Looms
markets-finance.excerpt: The Guardians of New Zealand Superannuation, managers of the NZ$93 billion fund with 9.93% average annual returns over two decades, say US-driven equity gains won't repeat — and have cut their own return expectations accordingly.
markets-finance.image_caption: Auckland, New Zealand. The NZ3 billion NZ Super Fund, headquartered in Auckland, has cut its long-term equity return assumptions, warning global equities are overvalued.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Indian diaspora retirement savers heavily weighted to US equities face the same valuation risk the world's top sovereign wealth fund is now warning about.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: AI Is Hitting Paychecks Before Payrolls, New Labor Data Show
markets-finance.excerpt: Research from Apollo, Stanford and a 138-million-worker study finds pay growth running slower in AI-exposed occupations — with the lowest-paid workers taking the largest hit — even as employment holds steady.
markets-finance.image_caption: An empty office chair carries a 'Replaced by AI' sign at a desk with a phone, computer mouse and eyeglasses. New labor research finds AI's measurable impact so far is showing up in slower wage growth and entry-level hiring freezes rather than in mass layoffs.
markets-finance.nri_angle: No natural India-specific angle; the data cover the U.S. labor market broadly.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: India Women Open Asian Games Title Defence Against Japan in Cricket Quarter-Final
sports.excerpt: Harmanpreet Kaur's defending champions face hosts Japan in the first-ever women's T20I between the sides, with the winner advancing to Saturday's semi-final against Bangladesh.
sports.image_caption: Shafali Verma bats for India. Defending champions India opened their Asian Games 2026 women's cricket title defence against hosts Japan at Korogi Athletic Park in Nisshin.
sports.nri_angle: Cricket's global moment — a World Cup nation facing an Associate host at a multi-sport Games — is exactly the kind of fixture that plays to diaspora audiences across time zones, with free DD Sports coverage and SonyLIV streaming.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Why India May Accept Asian Games Medals From Mohsin Naqvi After Asia Cup Snub
sports.excerpt: At the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, the medal protocol belongs to the OCA — and its Rule 66 bans podium demonstrations, meaning Indian cricketers are expected to accept medals from whoever is delegated, even ACC chief Mohsin Naqvi.
sports.image_caption: The Indian women's cricket team poses for a group photograph after winning the Women's Asia Cup 2026 final in Dubai. India twice refused to receive Asia Cup trophies from ACC chief Mohsin Naqvi, a protocol question that now moves to the Asian Games.
sports.nri_angle: For the diaspora, the protocol question crystallises the tension between national sentiment and sporting discipline: the same fans who cheered the trophy snub in Dubai will be watching closely to see how Indian cricketers handle a podium where the rules leave them no room to refuse.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Manu Bhaker and Tajinderpal Singh Toor to Carry India's Flag at Asian Games
sports.excerpt: Double Olympic medallist Manu Bhaker and two-time Asian Games shot put champion Tajinderpal Singh Toor will lead the Indian contingent into the Paloma Mizuho Stadium on September 19 as India aims to surpass its record Hangzhou medal haul.
sports.image_caption: Shooter Manu Bhaker (left) and shot putter Tajinderpal Singh Toor. The two champions will carry the Indian flag at the opening ceremony of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on September 19, 2026.
sports.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora, the flag-bearers are the familiar face of the contingent — Bhaker's Paris heroics made her a household name in Indian homes worldwide, and her walk into the Nagoya stadium will be one of the most-watched moments of the opening ceremony.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Why Japan's Cricket Moment Signals the Game's Global Ambition
sports.excerpt: Cricket's arrival in Japan — the Asian Games plus a historic first senior men's T20I against India on September 22 — is a deliberate bet on taking the game beyond its traditional markets, and the broadcast money is following.
sports.image_caption: India's men's T20I team, the reigning world champions, walk off the field. The side will face Japan for the first time in a senior men's T20I on September 22, 2026, ahead of the Asian Games cricket tournament.
sports.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora, Japan is the new front row — the Indian community in Japan gets a rare live sighting of the world champions, while the diaspora's global streaming audience is the commercial engine that makes a fixture like this worth broadcasting.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: India Open Asian Games Cricket Title Defence Against Hosts Japan
sports.excerpt: Defending champions India face hosts Japan in the women's T20 quarter-final on September 18, opening the bid to retain both the men's and women's cricket gold at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games.
sports.image_caption: An India women's cricket player smiles on the field during a match. India open their Asian Games 2026 title defence against hosts Japan in the women's T20 quarter-final on September 18.
sports.nri_angle: Cricket at a continental multi-sport event gives Japan's small but growing cricket community a home encounter with the world's strongest side, and Asian diaspora fans a familiar festival of rivalry inside a Games beyond the Commonwealth spotlight.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: IPL 2027 Auction Heads Back to India After Three Years Abroad
sports.excerpt: IPL chairman Arun Dhumal told PTI the mini auction is expected in mid-December on home soil, pending hotel availability during wedding season — while the controversial Impact Player rule also heads for a verdict.
sports.image_caption: IPL chairman Arun Dhumal holds the IPL trophy during a league event. Dhumal has confirmed the league is pushing to bring the 2027 player auction back to India after three overseas editions.
sports.nri_angle: The auction's return to Indian soil brings the IPL's signature off-field event back to diaspora fans who follow the bidding through Indian broadcasts and holiday-season watch parties, reinforcing the league's homecoming pull for NRIs traveling home in December.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: BCCI Names India ODI, T20I Squads for West Indies; Rohit Retains Place
sports.excerpt: Shubman Gill will captain a 15-man ODI squad for the three-match home series starting September 27, with Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli retained, Dhruv Jurel preferred over Rishabh Pant as the second wicketkeeper, and Shreyas Iyer set to lead the T20I side.
sports.nri_angle: The squad shapes India's buildup to the 2027 World Cup, a campaign millions of Indian-origin fans will follow across broadcast and streaming, while the inclusion of 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi shows how young the talent pipeline runs.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Messi to Get Buenos Aires Farewell in Final Argentina Appearance on Oct. 6
sports.excerpt: Named to Lionel Scaloni's squad despite retiring from international football on Aug. 31, Messi will play only the Oct. 6 friendly against Benin at the Estadio Monumental — his 208th cap and official send-off before Argentina's home fans.
sports.image_caption: Lionel Messi, who will play his final Argentina match at Buenos Aires' Estadio Monumental on October 6 against Benin.
sports.nri_angle: Messi's retirement lands hardest in Kerala and Kolkata, home to some of the world's most devoted Messi fanbases — from Kerala's ubiquitous giant cutouts to Kolkata's Messi-themed cafe — and for many Indian fans the Oct. 6 farewell is the proper goodbye they never got after the chaotic 2024 GOAT Tour stop.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Abhishek Sharma Rises to No. 2 as Bumrah Cracks ICC T20I Top 10
sports.excerpt: India's home series win over Afghanistan powered rankings gains across the board, with Varun Chakravarthy also climbing to fifth among T20I bowlers.
sports.image_caption: Jasprit Bumrah has broken into the top 10 of the ICC T20I bowling rankings as Abhishek Sharma rose to No. 2 among batters.
sports.nri_angle: Indian batters and bowlers dominating the T20I rankings is exactly the kind of home-nation sporting success that diaspora fans follow closely and celebrate.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: WPL Season 5 Auction Set for October 28 in Kochi, BCCI Confirms
sports.excerpt: The Board of Control for Cricket in India announced the fifth edition of the Women's Premier League will run from January 14 to February 7, 2027, with the player auction at the Grand Hyatt Kochi and a September 28 deadline for franchises to submit retention lists.
sports.image_caption: Royal Challengers Bengaluru players celebrate with the Women's Premier League trophy. The two-time champions are one of five franchises preparing for the season-five auction in Kochi on October 28.
sports.nri_angle: The WPL's mix of international stars and emerging Indian talent draws a global diaspora audience, and the October 28 Kochi auction will set the storylines NRI cricket fans in the US, UK and Australia follow through the 2027 season.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Rashid Khan Blames Shot Selection as India Close In on T20I Clean Sweep
sports.excerpt: After Afghanistan lost the second T20I by seven wickets in Delhi to hand India the series, Rashid Khan admitted his side misread the conditions and batted poorly, while BCCI vice-president Rajiv Shukla predicted a clean sweep in Thursday's final match at the Arun Jaitley Stadium.
sports.image_caption: Afghanistan players celebrate a wicket during the T20I series against India. Captain Rashid Khan took 3-36 in the second match in Delhi, where the visitors lost by seven wickets to hand India the series.
sports.nri_angle: The series, hosted in India with Afghanistan playing in front of Indian crowds, is closely followed by Afghan diaspora fans in the US and Europe and by Indian diaspora audiences whose IPL ties to Afghan stars like Rashid Khan and Mohammad Nabi add a personal thread to the fixture.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Salesforce Unveils AIforce and Koa Reasoning Model at Dreamforce 2026
technology.excerpt: At Dreamforce Day 1, Salesforce launched AIforce, a live interface layer that takes CRM to any tool, and Koa, its first CRM reasoning model built on NVIDIA Nemotron.
technology.image_caption: Salesforce's official artwork for AIforce, the live interface layer unveiled at Dreamforce 2026. The company also introduced Koa, its first CRM reasoning model built on NVIDIA Nemotron.
technology.nri_angle: Indian IT services firms and enterprise teams are among Salesforce's largest implementation partners globally, and the agent-interface shift promises a new services wave built around AIforce.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Apple Pay Eyes India Launch Next Month, Starting With Axis Bank Cards
technology.excerpt: Reuters reports Apple is poised to bring its tap-and-pay service to one of the last major markets where it is unavailable, with HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank also in talks but yet to agree terms.
technology.image_caption: An Apple logo on the glass facade of an Apple Store. Apple is poised to launch Apple Pay in India as early as next month, starting with Axis Bank cards, according to Reuters.
technology.nri_angle: NRIs visiting India will be able to tap-to-pay with Indian bank cards on their iPhones, and a future UPI integration could make Apple Pay the first global wallet with native access to India's payments network.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Tata Electronics Signs Five Semiconductor Partnerships in a Single Day
technology.excerpt: The Tata Electronics agreements — with Nexperia, Fujifilm, Besi, SCL and a skilling university — span chip fabrication, materials, advanced packaging and talent as India pushed to build a complete semiconductor ecosystem at SEMICON India 2026.
technology.image_caption: A silicon wafer under inspection. Tata Electronics signed five semiconductor partnerships on September 17, 2026, including wafer fabrication at its Dholera Fab with Dutch chipmaker Nexperia.
technology.nri_angle: The ecosystem push resonates with the Indian diaspora's deep bench in the global semiconductor industry, where Indian-origin engineers hold senior roles across major chip firms in the US, Taiwan and Europe — a talent pool Tata Electronics will need to complement as it stands up homegrown fabs.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: SEMICON India 2026: New Delhi Pushes to Localise Chip Materials and Gases
technology.excerpt: At the fifth SEMICON India summit in New Delhi, officials brokered roundtables with suppliers from the US, Japan and South Korea while Merck, Applied Materials and Lam Research announced India supply-chain commitments under the ₹1.275 lakh crore Semicon 2.0 programme.
technology.image_caption: A gloved hand holds a semiconductor chip under colored lighting. New Delhi is pushing to localise chip materials and gases ahead of SEMICON India 2026.
technology.nri_angle: The materials-and-equipment focus of Semicon 2.0 gives Indian-origin engineers and executives across the global semiconductor industry a concrete bridge — supplier partnerships, vendor parks and R&D collaboration — back into India's chip ecosystem.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Huawei's Xu: Chinese AI too weak yet to face frontier safety risks
technology.excerpt: At Huawei Connect in Shanghai, rotating chairman Eric Xu said only U.S. labs with massive compute can perceive frontier AI risks — and urged Chinese developers to accelerate, not slow down.
technology.image_caption: Huawei rotating chairman Eric Xu at a company event. Xu told reporters at Huawei Connect in Shanghai that Chinese AI developers have not yet reached the level where they can feel frontier safety risks.
technology.nri_angle: Huawei's AI-safety positioning, alongside China's agent-safety standards, will shape the guardrails around the AI products and developer tools used by millions across India and the global diaspora.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Applied Materials Pledges $5 Billion as Modi Opens SEMICON India 2026
technology.excerpt: Modi declared India has entered the second phase of its chip journey — 12 projects approved, a $13.5 billion mission budget — and urged semiconductor researchers abroad to join the buildout.
technology.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi opened SEMICON India 2026, where Applied Materials pledged a $5 billion investment. The chip equipment maker committed to expanding its India operations.
technology.nri_angle: Indians account for a fifth of the world's chip design workforce while India builds almost no chips; Modi's explicit call to researchers abroad makes the diaspora the talent lever for the mission.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Huawei says AI chip demand outstrips supply as it accelerates its Nvidia challenge
technology.excerpt: At its Huawei Connect conference in Shanghai, the Chinese giant unveiled 2027 AI chip launches and an architecture it claims lets a million processors work as one computer — while admitting it cannot make enough chips for China alone.
technology.image_caption: A Huawei logo sign hangs at a technology exhibition. Huawei announced new AI chip launches for 2027 and said it cannot produce enough AI computing equipment to meet demand in China.
technology.nri_angle: Indian professionals who staff the world's AI labs and semiconductor firms — including Nvidia — face the competitive pressure of Huawei's acceleration, while India's own chip ambitions are being shaped by the same U.S.-China contest.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Cisco discloses second actively exploited zero-day in a week, with maximum severity score
technology.excerpt: The new flaw, CVE-2026-76460, lets unauthenticated attackers bypass Cisco's Identity Services Engine to gain root access — days after a separate critical zero-day in Cisco's email gateways came under attack.
technology.image_caption: The Cisco logo. Cisco disclosed two actively exploited zero-day vulnerabilities within a week, the second carrying the maximum severity score.
technology.nri_angle: Indian IT professionals and managed-security teams — who run many of the world's enterprise networks and SOCs — are on the front line of this patching sprint, since ISE governs network access for the companies they support.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Infosys Opens 330,000-Square-Foot Indore Block for AI and Cloud Work
technology.excerpt: The SDB-2 building at the Super Corridor campus, inaugurated on September 16, expands the center's capacity in AI, cloud, and cybersecurity; the Indore site now employs more than 3,300 people.
technology.nri_angle: Infosys' Indore expansion adds AI and cloud delivery capacity serving its global enterprise clients while creating high-quality technology employment in central India, deepening the talent corridor that connects Indian engineers to worldwide markets.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Vishal Sikka's Hang Ten Systems Raises $53 Million in Second Seed Round
technology.excerpt: The enterprise AI services startup, founded in May by the former Infosys CEO, has now raised $85 million in total after Xora, Temasek's early-stage investment platform, led a $53 million extension closed just five weeks after its first seed round.
technology.nri_angle: The round spotlights a familiar diaspora arc: Vishal Sikka, who once ran Infosys from Bangalore as its first non-founder CEO, is now raising from Singapore's Temasek and Saudi capital in Palo Alto to build the AI-native services firm designed to succeed the labor-arbitrage IT-services model he used to lead.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Von der Leyen Backs AI Slowdown, Invites Frontier Labs for Talks
technology.excerpt: In her State of the Union address, the European Commission president said she will invite the leading AI labs to discuss pacing frontier development — putting Brussels at odds with a dismissive Washington.
technology.image_caption: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has backed calls to slow AI development and invited frontier labs for talks.
technology.nri_angle: Indian engineers are heavily represented at frontier labs like OpenAI and Anthropic, and India's AI startup ecosystem tracks EU rules closely — the EU–U.S. split on slowing down will shape the guardrails these companies ultimately follow.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Google Patches Pixel Modem Zero-Day Exploited in Targeted Attacks
technology.excerpt: The high-severity flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-58704, was a 'zero-click' attack that let attackers break out of the Pixel's cellular modem and reach the phone's broader data without any user interaction.
technology.image_caption: A Google Pixel phone. Google patched a modem zero-day on Pixel phones exploited in targeted attacks.
technology.nri_angle: India is one of the world's largest Android markets and Pixel phones are popular with Indian tech professionals at home and in the diaspora, so the fix matters directly to many in the community.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: 'Avengers: Endgame Encore' Smashes ₹5 Crore in India Advance Sales, Eyes Re-Release Record
entertainment.excerpt: A week before release, the Marvel reissue has sold 100,000 advance tickets and is gunning for Baahubali: The Epic's all-time re-release opening record.
entertainment.image_caption: Captain America wielding Mjolnir in ‘Avengers: Endgame.’ The film’s re-release is projected to set an India advance-sales record.
entertainment.nri_angle: Marvel's box-office clout in India — the diaspora's home-market moviegoing barometer — is back, with a re-release outpacing many fresh releases in advance sales.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Deepika and Ranveer Seek Siddhivinayak Blessings Ahead of Second Child's Birth
entertainment.excerpt: The couple repeated the Siddhivinayak pilgrimage they made before daughter Dua's birth, arriving in matching purple as Ganeshotsav filled Mumbai.
entertainment.image_caption: Deepika Padukone at a public appearance. The actor and husband Ranveer Singh visited the Siddhivinayak Temple in Mumbai ahead of the birth of their second child.
entertainment.nri_angle: Deepika and Ranveer's temple pilgrimage before each child's birth resonates with diaspora families who keep their own faith traditions alive across continents.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Marathi Thriller 'Gondhal' Is India's Official Entry for Oscars 2027
entertainment.excerpt: Santosh Davakhar's folk-ritual thriller, chosen from 33 contenders, becomes only the fourth Marathi film ever to carry India's Oscar flag.
entertainment.nri_angle: For the diaspora, India's Oscar entry is the annual moment Indian cinema speaks to Hollywood — and a Marathi folk-ritual thriller is the most unconventional choice in years.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Sajid Nadiadwala to Make Big-Budget Lalit Modi Biopic; Ranveer Singh Eyed for Lead
entertainment.excerpt: Pinkvilla reports Nadiadwala Grandson Entertainment is developing the IPL founder's life story with Sneha Rajani scripting — and Modi himself says Ranveer Singh visited him in London to discuss the role.
entertainment.image_caption: IPL founder Lalit Modi. Producer Sajid Nadiadwala is developing a big-budget biopic on his life, with Sneha Rajani leading the scripting.
entertainment.nri_angle: The IPL founder's life story — from building cricket's richest league to exile in London — has global resonance for a diaspora that made the league a worldwide phenomenon.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Konkona's Birthday Post for Amol Parashar Sparks 'Hard Launch' Frenzy
entertainment.excerpt: A playful reel for Amol Parashar's 40th birthday sent fans — and half of Bollywood's comment section — into speculation overdrive about the long-rumoured couple.
entertainment.image_caption: Konkona Sen Sharma and Amol Parashar appear together in a playful video. Konkona's Instagram reel for Amol's 40th birthday on September 17 prompted fans to call it a 'hard launch' of their rumoured relationship.
entertainment.nri_angle: Bollywood relationship speculation travels at fibre-optic speed through diaspora fan communities — a 'hard launch' from two actors as respected as Konkona and Amol dominates group chats from Edison to Edgbaston.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Vijay Sethupathi's 'Maharaja' Heads to Hollywood in Landmark Tamil Remake Deal
entertainment.excerpt: The 2024 neo-noir thriller will be the first Tamil film officially remade by a major Hollywood studio, after its ₹91.65 crore run in China caught the attention of an American agency.
entertainment.image_caption: Film stills show Vijay Sethupathi as the barber Maharaja, including the bloodied barber-chair sequence from the film. The producers announced on September 16 that the 2024 Tamil thriller will be remade in Hollywood by a major studio, billing it as the first Tamil film to get an official Hollywood adaptation.
entertainment.nri_angle: A Tamil thriller that reached diaspora audiences through Netflix is being re-imported to American screens, making it the first Tamil film to get a Hollywood remake.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Christopher Nolan's Odyssey Nears Hollywood's Top 6 All-Time in India
entertainment.excerpt: At ₹189.9 crore after 52 days, the Nolan epic needs only a fraction more to pass Avatar: Fire And Ash's ₹190.5 crore and claim the No. 6 spot among Hollywood's biggest Indian grossers ever.
entertainment.image_caption: A still from Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey. After 52 days in theaters, the epic has collected ₹188.14 crore net in India and is closing in on Avatar: Fire And Ash for sixth place among Hollywood’s all-time Indian grossers.
entertainment.nri_angle: The Odyssey's India haul shows Indian audiences reshaping Hollywood's global records, giving diaspora moviegoers a homegrown box-office storyline to celebrate alongside the film's worldwide success.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: From Phoolan to Nagaland's First Feature, Indian Cinema Takes Over Toronto
entertainment.excerpt: Months after Cannes selected no Indian film in any section, the Toronto International Film Festival has programmed Indian titles across five sections — from Richie Mehta's Phoolan to a 4K restoration of John Abraham's 1986 Malayalam classic Amma Ariyan.
entertainment.nri_angle: Toronto is home to one of the largest Indian diaspora communities in the world, where Indian films routinely sell out at TIFF — for many NRIs, the festival's Indian lineup is a first look at the films that will dominate conversation back home and on streaming.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Meghna Gulzar on Irrfan Khan: 'Everything He Did, He Made Me Look Good'
entertainment.excerpt: Speaking to The Indian Express's Expresso series ahead of Daayra's September 18 release, the Raazi and Talvar director reflected on Irrfan Khan, Vicky Kaushal and Deepika Padukone — and said she still doesn't know which side of Talvar Irrfan believed.
entertainment.image_caption: Filmmaker Meghna Gulzar with Irrfan Khan. She directed him as investigator DCP Ashwin Kumar in Talvar.
entertainment.nri_angle: For diaspora audiences who know Talvar and Raazi primarily through streaming, the Expresso conversation offers a rare window into how one of Hindi cinema's most restrained directors draws performances from its most demanding actors.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Mandakini on Ram Teri Ganga Maili at 41: 'I Went With the Flow'
entertainment.excerpt: Four decades after Raj Kapoor's 1985 classic made her a star, the actress has reflected on the film's controversial scenes, telling The Indian Express's Expresso series that as a young newcomer she simply trusted her director and followed his vision.
entertainment.image_caption: Actor Mandakini. She starred in Raj Kapoor's Ram Teri Ganga Maili, which turned 41 this year.
entertainment.nri_angle: For the diaspora generation that grew up watching the film on VHS tapes and cable reruns, the Expresso conversation is a nostalgic re-examination of a film whose most famous scenes overshadowed everything else about it.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: India Reconstitutes Censor Board With 18 New Members, Including Grammy Winner Ricky Kej
entertainment.excerpt: The Information and Broadcasting Ministry has appointed an 18-member Central Board of Film Certification for a three-year term, naming actors Suniel Shetty, Pankaj Tripathi and Preity Zinta, filmmakers Priyadarshan and Nila Madhab Panda, and Grammy-winning composer Ricky Kej to the panel that certifies films for public exhibition.
entertainment.image_caption: A collage shows Suniel Shetty, Preity Zinta, Priyadarshan and Pankaj Tripathi. All four were named among the 18 members of the reconstituted Central Board of Film Certification announced on September 16, 2026.
entertainment.nri_angle: The CBFC-certified version of a film is the version that plays in Indian cinemas and typically shapes diaspora entertainment debates abroad, so the industry-led board's certification calls will matter to Bollywood's large NRI audiences in the Gulf, the US, the UK and Canada.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Anant Nag to Receive Dadasaheb Phalke Award; Modi Hails 'Remarkable Versatility'
entertainment.excerpt: The Kannada cinema veteran, whose career spans five decades and more than 300 films, will receive Indian cinema's highest honour at the 72nd National Film Awards in Kevadia on September 22.
entertainment.image_caption: Kannada cinema veteran Anant Nag, named the recipient of the Dadasaheb Phalke Award, India's highest film honour. Prime Minister Narendra Modi hailed his remarkable versatility.
entertainment.nri_angle: For the Kannada and Indian diaspora worldwide — a large audience in the US and Gulf — Nag's Malgudi Days and five-decade filmography are shared cultural memory, making the honour a moment of community pride beyond India.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Katrina Kaif on Postpartum Skin, Beauty Standards and Feeling Her Best
lifestyle-health.excerpt: After facing trolling over her postpartum appearance, the actor says motherhood rebuilt her approach to skincare — and to what beauty means.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Katrina Kaif at a recent appearance. The actor has spoken about postpartum body image after facing online trolling.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: The postpartum body-shaming debate resonates with diaspora mothers navigating the same pressures across cultures — where family scrutiny can be as sharp as social media's.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Peter Chan Brought a Chengdu Dementia Care Home's Motto to Toronto
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The veteran filmmaker drew on guidance from a Chengdu Alzheimer's care facility — "go with the flow, know when to stop" — while directing his early-onset dementia drama, starring Zhou Xun, which premieres at TIFF on September 18.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A film still from ‘The Road Not Taken’ shows the central family sharing a meal around a dinner table at night, the warm-lit scene viewed through a doorway. The Peter Chan-directed drama stars Zhou Xun as a television host confronting early-onset Alzheimer’s and premieres at the Toronto International Film Festival on September 18, 2026.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: In diaspora families where dementia is often handled privately with correction as the default, the Chengdu care home's counsel — don't argue with a drifting mind, and know when to let go — names a tension many caregivers of aging immigrant parents live with daily.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: India bars stem cell therapy for autism as routine care
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The health ministry's September 16 advisory says any stem cell use for autism must remain confined to duly approved clinical trials, following a January 2026 Supreme Court order; unauthorized treatment can now mean professional misconduct charges.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A clinical research laboratory shown in the reporting on the health ministry advisory. The September 16 advisory bars stem cell therapy for autism as routine care, restricting it to duly approved clinical trials under the ICMR-DBT 2017 guidelines.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: NRI parents exploring stem-cell clinics in India for autistic children now face a clear rule: commercial treatment is barred, and legitimate access runs only through approved clinical trials.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: From Navratri to Diwali: Dermatologists' Dos and Don'ts for Festive Skin
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Nine nights of Garba, late-night parties and weeks of heavy makeup take a toll — dermatologists say the festive glow comes down to preparation, non-comedogenic makeup and double cleansing, not last-minute miracles.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Whether you're doing Garba in New Jersey or Diwali in Dallas, the dermatologists' advice travels: the glow is built in the weeks before the first diya, not the morning of.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: The Turmeric Co. Takes Turmeric Shots to UK Clinics to Fight 'Pain Pandemic'
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The functional-shot brand founded by ex-footballer Thomas Robson-Kanu is partnering healthcare practitioners across the UK to reach patients needing preventive solutions for inflammation and pain — putting Ayurveda's best-known root at the centre of a mainstream healthcare conversation.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: For South Asian consumers in the UK who grew up on haldi doodh, The Turmeric Co.'s clinic push is Ayurveda's most familiar ingredient going mainstream through a healthcare front door.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: A 50-Millisecond Sound Burst Can Help Your Brain Wash Itself at Night
lifestyle-health.excerpt: MIT researchers found that playing tiny bursts of pink noise at the precise peak of deep-sleep brain waves strengthens the flow of cerebrospinal fluid that clears metabolic waste — a discovery published in Science Translational Medicine with implications for Alzheimer's research.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: For households already debating white-noise machines and sleep trackers, the study suggests the future of sleep technology may be about timing — not volume.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Heart Surgeon Warns Smoking, Vaping Damage the Body 'From Top to Toes'
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Board-certified cardiothoracic surgeon Dr Jeremy London says smoking in any form — tobacco, marijuana or vaping — is "the single worst thing you can do for your entire body," urging smokers to get help and those around them to offer support.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A metal ashtray filled with extinguished cigarette butts. Heart surgeon Dr Jeremy London warns that smoking and vaping in any form is the single worst thing for the body, damaging blood vessels and organs from the top of the head to the tip of the toes.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asian diaspora tobacco use spans hookah, bidis and smokeless forms often left out of smoking conversations; Dr London's all-inhaled-forms warning and vaping alarm speak directly to those blind spots.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Ayurveda Expert Shares 21-Day Routine for Glowing Skin, Centered on Gut Health
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Dr Hansa Yogendra, director of The Yoga Institute in Mumbai, has laid out a three-week regimen built around a simple ginger-cardamom morning drink, gentle Ayurvedic skincare rituals and diet — arguing that radiant skin starts with a healthy gut.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Dr Hansa Yogendra, director of The Yoga Institute in Mumbai, who outlined the 21-day routine for glowing skin.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: The routine's ingredients — ginger, cardamom, turmeric, besan, rose water — are staples in most Indian diaspora kitchens, making this an accessible, culturally familiar wellness practice rather than a product to buy.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Sepsis Kills 11 Million a Year. Handwashing and Vaccines Can Stop It
lifestyle-health.excerpt: World Sepsis Day put the spotlight on a condition behind one in five global deaths — and the simple prevention steps experts say too many people skip.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: With India recording 11.3 million sepsis cases and 2.9 million deaths in 2020, diaspora families with elderly relatives or newborns — at home or visiting India — have the most to gain from hand hygiene, vaccination and knowing the warning signs.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: PCOS Is Now PMOS: Doctors Say the New Name Changes Women's Care
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The hormonal condition long known as polycystic ovary syndrome has been renamed Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome — a change doctors say should push care beyond period regulation toward metabolic and mental health.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: For Indian-origin families who know the condition as PCOD, the PMOS rename reframes it as the whole-body metabolic and mental-health condition it is — with South Asian women's elevated diabetes and heart-disease risk making that reframing especially consequential.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Vikrant Massey Turns 'Musafir Cafe' Into Real Hill Cafés in Himachal and Uttarakhand
food.excerpt: The actor's production house Homemade Stories is building two replicas of the show's café — plus around 20 artist-residency rooms — extending the Netflix series' world beyond the screen.
food.image_caption: Vikrant Massey in Musafir Cafe, the Netflix series where he plays Chander. The actor is building two real-life replicas of the show's café in Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand.
food.nri_angle: For diaspora travellers heading to the Himalayan hills, Massey's cafés add two new screen-famous addresses to the map — with artist residencies that echo the show's creative-retreat theme.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: After Ganpati Visarjan, Where Does All the Waste Actually Go?
food.excerpt: Mumbai's first immersion round is done — 61,640 idols into artificial ponds and the sea. With the September 25 finale approaching, the city's waste machinery, and its controversies, swing into action.
food.image_caption: Broken Ganesh idols and debris lie on a Mumbai beach after immersion. The BMC has built more than 275 artificial ponds for this year's Ganeshotsav and requires idols under six feet to use them.
food.nri_angle: Ganesh Chaturthi is celebrated by Indian communities from New Jersey to Singapore, and the eco-idol debate travels with it — many diaspora mandals have already moved to clay idols and symbolic home visarjan, a quieter version of Mumbai's reckoning.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Michelin-Selected KEK Brings Singapore's Zi Char Cuisine to Bengaluru
food.excerpt: Keng Eng Kee Seafood, the 1970s-born zi char institution now run by three siblings, carries its wok hei and Michelin recognition to one of India's most adventurous food cities.
food.image_caption: A chef works a flaming wok in the kitchen of Keng Eng Kee Seafood in Singapore. The Michelin-selected zi char restaurant is bringing its cuisine to Bengaluru.
food.nri_angle: KEK is already a landmark for Indian-Singaporean families, so its arrival in Bengaluru closes a small cultural loop — a cuisine shaped partly by Singapore's Indian community coming home to an Indian city.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: India's sugar prices hold near record highs as festive demand mounts
food.excerpt: Retail sugar touched ₹85/kg in some markets as weak rains and disease cut production, forcing duty-free imports and stock limits weeks before Diwali.
food.image_caption: A worker at a traditional sweets shop stands behind a glass display stacked with trays and gift boxes of Indian mithai. With retail sugar prices touching Rs 85/kg in some markets, sweet-makers and shoppers are paying more as Diwali approaches.
food.nri_angle: Diaspora families face costlier Diwali: mithai gift parcels to India cost more, and Indian sweet shops abroad that price off Indian wholesale markets are likely to pass the sugar surge on to festive shelves.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Diwali Rush Lifts Indian Food Exports as Global Buyers Stock Up on Sweets and Snacks
food.excerpt: A Trade Promotion Council of India survey of overseas buyers shows festive-season orders running about 6 percent above last year, with Gulf markets leading and ready-to-eat foods growing fastest.
food.image_caption: An assortment of Indian mithai, including ladoo, barfi, and chamcham garnished with pistachios and almonds. Traditional sweets are leading Diwali-season export demand, with a Trade Promotion Council of India survey showing overseas orders running about 6 percent above last year.
food.nri_angle: For Indian-origin families abroad, Diwali tables are getting better stocked as exports rise — Indian gulab jamun is now among the UK's most popular desserts and US retailers like Costco stock festive sweets for 4.4 million Indian Americans.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Two Delhi Founders Built a Rs 30 Crore Cold Coffee Chain in Two Years
food.excerpt: Shiv Dhawan and Sohrab Sitaram's First Coffee bet on small-format stores, cold coffee and sub-Rs 300 prices — and grew revenue roughly tenfold in a single year.
food.image_caption: The exterior of a First Coffee outlet, the Delhi specialty-coffee brand founded by Shiv Dhawan and Sohrab Sitaram. The company says it reached 25 outlets and roughly Rs 30 crore in FY26 revenue, with cold coffee driving 67% of sales.
food.nri_angle: No direct diaspora angle — the story is a domestic Indian consumer business — though its small-format, grab-and-go model mirrors the specialty-coffee formats diaspora coffee drinkers know from the US and UK.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Allahabad Vendor's One-Rupee Mini Samosas Win Hearts After 22 Years
food.excerpt: A Prayagraj street vendor's bite-sized samosas, priced at just Re 1 each for a reported 22 years and served with green chutney, have become social media's latest street-food sensation.
food.image_caption: Two samosas served with chutney on a steel plate. A street vendor in Allahabad (Prayagraj) sells bite-sized samosas for just Re 1 each. (Wikimedia Commons / Gaurav Dhwaj Khadka, CC BY-SA 4.0)
food.nri_angle: The samosa is the diaspora's most recognisable snack, and this story resonates as the samosa stripped to its essence — hot, crisp and cheap — a taste of street food no restaurant version quite replaces.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Ranveer Brar's Tandoori Corn Chaat Turns an Evening Snack Spicy
food.excerpt: Celebrity chef Ranveer Brar's step-by-step tandoori corn chaat dresses sweet corn in a spiced curd marinade, chars it, and finishes it chaat-style — a smoky upgrade to the classic evening snack.
food.image_caption: Chef Ranveer Brar, whose tandoori corn chaat recipe reworks the classic evening snack with a spiced curd marinade and charred finish.
food.nri_angle: The recipe recreates rainy-evening bhutta nostalgia for the diaspora using supermarket sweet corn, pantry Indian spices and an air fryer or broiler as a stand-in for the roadside coal grill.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: The Aachi of Chettinad: Meenakshi Meyyappan Keeps a Century-Old Cuisine Honest
food.excerpt: At 89, the matriarch of The Bangala in Karaikudi has spent two decades preserving Chettinad cooking as her family made it — temperate, subtle, and ground fresh on the ammi.
food.image_caption: Meenakshi Meyyappan holds a copy of The Bangala Table, the cookbook of 150 Chettinad recipes she co-authored. The 89-year-old matriarch founded The Bangala heritage hotel in Karaikudi in 2000.
food.nri_angle: For Tamil diaspora families whose Chettinad recipes have been simplified in migration, The Bangala Table and the festival offer a living reference for the cuisine's original restraint and technique.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: All Spicy, All Vegetarian, All Curry: Three Indian Food Myths That Persist
food.excerpt: Three labels — spicy, vegetarian, curry — get applied to all Indian food, and all three fall apart on contact with an actual Indian kitchen.
food.image_caption: Dosas and idlis served with sambar reflect only one regional tradition of Indian cooking. The article debunks three persistent myths about Indian food: that it is all spicy, all vegetarian, and all 'curry'.
food.nri_angle: Second-generation Indian Americans who grew up eating one regional cuisine often discover through myth-busting pieces like this that "Indian food" as a category is far wider than their family's table.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Bhog Indian Restaurant in Somerset Taps Nar Singh as Assistant Sous Chef
food.excerpt: The central New Jersey restaurant has brought in a chef with nearly 14 years of experience across India and the U.S., including stints at Shangri-La properties and Chote Nawab.
food.image_caption: Chef Nar Singh poses for a photograph. Bhog Indian Restaurant in Somerset, New Jersey, has named him its new assistant sous chef.
food.nri_angle: Chefs trained in India's luxury hotel kitchens increasingly anchor the U.S. Indian restaurant scene, and this hire reflects the continued professionalisation of New Jersey's Indian dining market.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Waiting Until Diwali to Buy a Car? Check Official Dates Before You Delay
travel.excerpt: Five launches are reportedly lined up for the festive window, but only Hyundai's Bayon has manufacturer documentation behind it — the rest lack official dates.
travel.image_caption: A Tata Safari SUV. The Safari EV is among the models reportedly lined up for the Diwali 2026 festive window, though Tata has not officially confirmed a launch date.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs visiting India for Diwali often time vehicle purchases for family to the festive season; verifying launch dates against official documentation avoids costly delays.

travel.title: Udaipur's Ganesh Emporium Turns Antique Textiles Into a Travel Destination
travel.excerpt: In a restored 17th-century haveli, designer Vipul Shah's family has turned a 1980s textile shop into one of Udaipur's most-visited cultural stops — where shoppers come for the stories as much as the bags.
travel.image_caption: Handbags from the Vipul Shah line, fashioned from vintage Rajasthani textiles. The bags are sold at Ganesh Emporium in Udaipur, the family-run, 65-gallery emporium housed in a restored 17th-century haveli.
travel.nri_angle: For diaspora travellers visiting Rajasthan, Ganesh Emporium offers a souvenir with a documented past — vintage textiles rooted in Rajasthani craft traditions rather than generic tourist-market goods.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Parineeti Chopra Calls JOALI Maldives' Villas the Best After Motherhood Getaway
travel.excerpt: The actor shared glimpses from her art-immersive island stay on Muravandhoo Island, praising the resort's design, personalised service and food while calling the trip perfect 'me time'.
travel.image_caption: Parineeti Chopra during her stay at JOALI Maldives. She called the resort's accommodation "the best villas in the Maldives" on a trip she described as the perfect recipe for "me time".
travel.nri_angle: The Maldives is one of the top luxury destinations for Indian and diaspora travellers, and celebrity resort endorsements like Chopra's continue to steer booking interest from that audience.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Flydubai Partners Air India, Uzbekistan Airways to Add 80 Destinations
travel.excerpt: The Dubai-based carrier's new interline agreements give its passengers single-ticket access to more than 80 additional destinations across Asia, Australia and Europe, taking its partner network to 46 airlines and its combined reach past 300 destinations worldwide.
travel.image_caption: The tails of flydubai, Uzbekistan Airways and Air India aircraft stand side by side. Flydubai announced interline agreements with the two airlines on September 16, 2026, adding more than 80 destinations to its network.
travel.nri_angle: Indian diaspora travellers routing through Dubai gain single-ticket access to tier-two Indian cities like Jaipur, Pune, Chandigarh and Varanasi, simplifying the multi-leg journeys many NRI families make to India each year.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Air India to Launch India's First UATP Corporate Travel Payment Program
travel.excerpt: The Tata-owned carrier will let companies and travel agencies buy tickets through a single centralized UATP account instead of juggling cards and payment methods for every traveler.
travel.image_caption: Air India check-in counters at Hong Kong International Airport Terminal 1. Air India will become the first airline in India to offer UATP accounts, letting businesses and travel agencies buy tickets through a single centralized account.
travel.nri_angle: Indian businesses and NRI professionals who book Air India through corporate programs or travel agencies will see tickets settle through a single account, reducing expense friction and opening access to negotiated corporate fares.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Indian Migrant First Person Charged Under UK's New Online Immigration Crime Law

carousel.nri_angle: Dengue surges hit Kerala's families — and the diaspora that travels home during monsoon season — making advance forecasting a lifeline for return visits.
